description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy and correlation of different sentence embedding methods compared to a baseline. The vertical axis represents accuracy and correlation, ranging from 0 to 1, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists four different methods: Single-task baseline, Baseline with Adaptive Dropout, Unsupervised SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE. Each method is represented by a group of three bars, each bar corresponding to a different metric: Sentiment Accuracy (light yellow), STS Correlation (pink), and Paraphrase Accuracy (light blue). The bars are not sorted in any specific order. The Sentiment Accuracy bars are consistently the shortest across all methods, while the Paraphrase Accuracy bars are the tallest, indicating higher values. The STS Correlation bars vary in height, with the 2-Tier SimCSE method showing the highest correlation. The chart does not include any annotations or visual emphasis on specific bars.
